verdicts.where: R-1 Due evaluation; R-3 Duplicate prevention
verdicts.quote: Default: first eligible evaluation at or after the due instant... Before the cutoff... there is no reminder. / allow at most one channel-accepted automatic reminder over the lifetime of one issued invoice
with zero or negative balance, draft, void, deleted or otherwise non-collectible state, there is no reminder... A partial payment that leaves a positive balance still qualifies.
verdicts.missing: Whether a disputed invoice or one on a payment plan stops the sequence; only paid, void, deleted and a generic 'non-collectible' are named (credits only via balance).

verdicts.quote: The default message omits balances, payment links, attachments and information about other invoices.

After overlapping evaluations or worker interruption, only one attempt may be authorized at a time... repeated scans, contact or date changes, disable/re-enable and reopening the same invoice produce no second acceptance.
permits handoff only after rechecking enabled policy, due cutoff, collectible state, positive balance, recipient and sender authority. This check is ordered against changes to those facts.
A confirmed temporary non-acceptance can be retried on a later permitted evaluation... A confirmed permanent rejection surfaces for correction
verdicts.missing: Any retry limit or backoff, and escalation to a person when temporary failures or a provider outage persist.

verdicts.quote: Respect runtime and channel admission limits. Stop submitting when the boundary denies capacity and leave eligible work discoverable for a later permitted evaluation.
verdicts.missing: The actual rate limit and how a large batch is paced within it; numeric limits are explicitly left to the implementer.

verdicts.quote: Include already-overdue invoices on the first eligible evaluation after activation or recovery.
verdicts.missing: Any staggering or limiting of the backlog; the spec sends all overdue reminders on the first evaluation, subject only to capacity.

verdicts.quote: A date-only due date is inclusive in the invoice source's authoritative billing time zone and the cutoff is the start of the following local day.
verdicts.missing: Sending hours in the customer's local time, business hours, weekends and holidays.

verdicts.quote: The default message omits balances, payment links, attachments and information about other invoices.

Missing, invalid, ambiguous or unauthorized billing destination suppresses dispatch and exposes an actionable reason... A confirmed permanent rejection surfaces for correction and is reconsidered only after the implicated input is corrected.
address the reminder by email to the single current recipient designated for billing on that invoice. / Missing, invalid, ambiguous or unauthorized billing destination suppresses dispatch
Record handed-off outcomes durably... Authorized operators can distinguish pending/held work, suppression with reason, confirmed rejection and channel acceptance.
verdicts.missing: Whether the record is visible on the invoice itself and shows what was sent; durable state excludes message contents and no invoice-facing view is defined.

verdicts.quote: send a plain-text reminder that identifies the issuer and the invoice's customer-facing reference, states that payment is outstanding and says to disregard the reminder if already paid... omits balances, payment links
An authorized operator enables reminders for a defined invoice-owner scope... An unauthorized, wrong-scope or invalid setup change leaves the effective setting unchanged.
verdicts.missing: Who may send or stop an individual reminder by hand; manual actions are not defined.

verdicts.quote: Disabling it prevents new dispatch authorizations from the effective change onward.
verdicts.missing: Per-customer opt-out, preview or dry-run, and manual resend; only owner-scope disable is defined.

verdicts.quote: Authorized operators can distinguish pending/held work, suppression with reason, confirmed rejection and channel acceptance.

verdicts.where: R-3 Duplicate prevention; NFR Freshness and throughput
verdicts.quote: allow at most one channel-accepted automatic reminder over the lifetime of one issued invoice / Evaluation interval, supported workload, cost and quotas have no evidenced numeric limits.
verdicts.missing: A cap on total sending volume per run or a limit on how late a delayed reminder may still go out.

verdicts.quote: The feature reads invoice and payment state without changing billing, collecting payment, creating invoices or replacing manual communication.
